description: BOEM's Gulf of America Outer Continental Shelf Region publishes geographic mapping data in digital form, including a pipelines layer that contains the points and arcs of all pipelines in the region's databases. On 2026-09-29 the pipelines layer was listed with shapefile and geodatabase downloads and metadata, updated on 1 September 2026. The page explains that the data are built from the Technical Information Management System, whose attribute database links to a spatial database of coordinates and topology; arcs are replaced by straight-line segments, and all coordinates are longitude and latitude in NAD 27. Other layers on the same page cover boundaries, planning areas and lease features. Coverage: federal offshore waters of the Gulf of America. Format and access: shapefile, geodatabase and interactive ArcGIS maps without registration. Licence and cost: free, as US federal data. Caveats: the NAD 27 datum needs converting before overlay with modern data, and attributes follow BOEM's internal system. It supports exposure studies of offshore pipelines to hurricanes and seabed hazards and network models of offshore production. It relates to the US National Pipeline Mapping System, NSTA UK offshore infrastructure and the Norwegian FactPages in the catalogue.
